summary: Genmab A/S filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Danish company announcement (No. 48) disclosing transactions in its own shares by a managerial employee under Article 19 of the EU Market Abuse Regulation (equivalent to a US Section 16 insider transaction report). Chief Commercial Officer Bradley Bailey sold 1,071 shares on 2026-11-11 on Nasdaq Copenhagen across prices from DKK 3,592.00 to DKK 3,625.00, aggregating DKK 3,602.98 per share. The disclosure is routine insider-dealing transparency with no corporate action, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms; no deal or special-situation angle to watch.
